summary: Split the sentence into words and take the biggest length (T3 — string processing). `split()` does all the hard work of finding where words start and end.

blocks.title: Read the whole sentence
blocks.text: A plain `input()` keeps the spaces, which we need to find the words.

blocks.title: Find the longest word
blocks.text: `split()` with no argument breaks on any run of spaces and never returns empty strings. `max(len(word) for word in …)` checks every word, including the last one — the one a hand-written space counter usually forgets.

complexity: Time O(L) with L ≤ 200 characters — instant.
pitfalls: `split(' ')` returns empty strings when there are double spaces.
Counting letters by hand and missing the last word (it has no space after it).
